tables.name: users
tables.description: Stores the authenticated MVP user record.

tables.name: boards
tables.description: One board per user for the MVP; future-ready for multi-board support.

tables.name: columns
tables.description: Board columns. Titles are editable by the user, while the column ordering is preserved.

tables.name: cards
tables.description: Kanban cards attached to a board column.

notes: The MVP uses a single board per user, but the schema is modeled to allow future multi-board and multi-user expansion.
Column reorder and card positions are stored as integers so drag-and-drop movement is deterministic and easy to serialize to the UI.
The password field is intentionally represented as a hash even though the MVP uses a hardcoded sign-in flow, to keep the model future-proof.
SQLite is the database engine because the app runs locally and the project scope is intentionally small.
